title: Article XI transitional effect debt register
authority: Constitution Article XI.6; emptied by Phase 108
scope: Unmigrated effect-capable statements under holdspeak/ in the five ratified census families. Migrated, read, exempt-computation, and confined statements remain machine-pinned by tests/unit/test_kernel_effect_fence.py.
counting_rule: Count statements, not logical user actions. A statement leaves this transitional register only with a machine-asserted enforcement or exemption proof.
legal_effect: The register is empty: no declared path acts outside the kernel. Any new unclassified effect statement fails the fence and must be migrated or explicitly adjudicated before merge.

status_definitions.bypass: A reachable route avoids all named audited chokepoints.
status_definitions.mixed: Covered and bypass routes share this statement; treated as debt.
status_definitions.dormant: No current production caller, but the ambient capability can execute without a named chokepoint; treated as debt.
